name: SlapRF
subtitle: 5.8 GHz FPV Race & Practice Timing System
description: Open-source 5.8 GHz FPV gate timer with native CoreBluetooth Hub, ESP32-P4 PoE Bridge (:5480), spoken callouts, and MultiGP tournament sync.

apps.name: SlapRF
apps.subtitle: 5.8 GHz FPV Gate Timer & Race Director
apps.localizedDescription: Native iOS and iPadOS SlapRF timing engine supporting SlapRF Bluetooth Hubs, ESP32-P4 PoE Ethernet Bridges (:5480), LapRF 8-Way (:5403), RotorHazard, offline bbolt storage, low-latency gate crossing beeps, voice callouts, and Wi-Fi LAN multi-display sharing.

versions.localizedDescription: SlapRF v0.0.20 native iOS and iPadOS release.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: SlapRF uses Bluetooth LE to connect to your SlapRF Hub gate timer and stream live 5.8 GHz lap passes.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SlapRF uses your local network to connect to SlapRF PoE Bridges, LapRF 8-Way, and RotorHazard timers, and to share live race results over Wi-Fi.
